newsitem.title: USA: Veritas adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Veritas adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Veritas DGC Inc said Tuesday that it adopted a shareholder rights plan, under which each holder of record at the close of business on June 12 will receive one Series A preferred stock purchase right for each common share held.
Each right entitles the shareholder to purchase one one-thousandth of a preferred share for $100, Veritas said.
Each such fraction of a preferred share has terms designed to make it essentially equivalent to one share of common stock, the company said.

The rights will become exercisable only in the event a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock or commences a tender or exchange offer which, if consummated, would result in that person or group owning 15 percent of the common stock.
Prior to such an event, the rights will be evidenced by and traded in tandem with the common stock or exchangeable shares, as applicable, Veritas said.
The company said the plan has not been adopted in response to any known effort to acquire control.
"It is simply precautionary," the company said.
